WORDS FROM MY HEART

For you, always

31 October 2026 ❤️

Feliz aniversário, meu amor!! ❤️

Your 25th birthday should be as special and beautiful as you are!! ❤️

I wish I could give you a handwritten letter, but even a whole library full of books would never be enough for me to express how much I love you. ❤️

Since you entered my life, everything has had a meaning. I still remember the first letter you wrote to me, when you told me that you had found your home. And now I have to tell you something: with you, I found my whole life. ❤️

Com você, encontrei a minha vida inteira.

You are my soulmate, my safe harbour, and the absolute owner of my heart. Just one smile from you can change my whole mood, my whole day, and make everything feel better. 🤍🤍

My biggest mission in this life is simply to be with you, to love you, and to make you the happiest person in the world. ❤️

There is nothing on this earth that could ever compare to a look from your beautiful eyes, the touch of your hand, a kiss from your lips, or one of your hugs that makes me forget even my own name.

I pray that I get to grow old next to you, skin to skin, heart to heart, hand in hand. To wake up beside you, to share every little moment with you, and to spend the rest of my life loving you more and more every day. ❤️

And even though we are far apart, even though we are not in the same country yet, not under the same roof, and not waking up next to each other every morning, I can still feel your love filling my heart every single day. I can still feel your scent surrounding me, see your beautiful smile whenever I close my eyes, and feel you close to me no matter how many miles are between us.

And I know that one day, there will be no more distance, no more goodbyes, and no more wishing you were here. Just you and me, together, exactly where we belong. ❤️

Happy 25th birthday, my love. I hope this year brings you all the happiness you deserve, and I hope I get to be the reason behind so many of your smiles, today and for the rest of our lives. ❤️

Eu te amo, Gabi. Eu te amo muito, muito. Hoje, amanhã e por toda a minha vida. ❤️

More than words could ever explain. 🤍

Forever yours,
Refoo ♡
